text_block_list.text:
A few nights later, under a full moon...
Still in Love called me out.
—To the place where we first met.
Come to think of it,
that night was a full moon, too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is a full moon.
The primal blood flowing within me...
knows no slumber.
The moonlight exposes that blood...
Perhaps that is why.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My instincts ache so much...
...Ngh, it's unbearable.

The "her" within Still in Love is already
beginning to stir.
Feeling my heart race...
I give the instruction,
trying to keep my voice from trembling.
choice_data_list: All right, let's have you run a bi...
All right, let's have you run a bi...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
...Um, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If that child comes out...
Could you let me hear your voice?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please don't ask why. ...Not yet.
............May I count on you?
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...—
Thank you very much.

Bathed in the moonlight,
Still in Love dashed forward.
Her graceful,
textbook running form began to contort—
warping with each surge of acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh,
ah... My heart is churning...
She's waking up!
Even though they are watching...! Ah,
but... but...—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... AHAHAHA! Haa... Ahh, yes,
this is it...! Moon,
pour down even more...—
strip "ME" wide open!

Unshackled from reason,
her raw instincts rejoiced in madness...
For a moment, I stood spellbound.
But remembering what she had asked of me...
I screamed.
choice_data_list: Still... Can you hear me, Still?!
Still... Can you hear me, Still?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: AhahaHAHAHAhahahahahahaHAhahaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(—...I can hear them...
I have to go... I have to go back...
But...—where to?)

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Eww... No way,
I don't wanna run with Still-chan!
She's, like, super weird...

text_block_list.name: Adult
text_block_list.text:
That girl looks like an entirely different
person...
...How creepy...

text_block_list.name: Young Still
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... *hic*... No... That's not it...
That isn't "me"...

Frightening... Terrifying...
She's insane...
Creepy... Weird... Abnormal...—A monster.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Nowhere. There's nowhere for me to belong...
Because we... are broken.
Frightening...
There's no one in this world who could ever
love me...—)

『Your instincts...
are frighteningly beautiful.』

『Your instincts...
are frighteningly beautiful.』

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Only them. Only that person...
acknowledged me.
They accepted... "me"...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Even someone like me... can be loved?
Is it okay to love them? May I...
believe in them...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I have to go! Back to their side...!
Because... because... you are... my...—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Still is...
right here...—

I rushed over to her as she came to a halt.
At last, reason
had triumphed over instinct...
She had regained her senses through sheer
willpower.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Do you love me?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Do you love me? Doyouloveme DOYOULOVEME?
DoyouLOVEME doyouloveme doyouLOVEme
Love me love me?
Love me love me love me love me? Love me

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: 'Cause you're—MY fated person.

A powerful grip seized my shoulders.
That thing curled its lips into a wicked
grin,
and just as its jaws parted wide—
she crumpled to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Eh...?
...Eeeek?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I am so terribly sorry...!
To think I was... lying right on your lap,
Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. More importa...
Don't worry about it. More importa...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... ...Y-Yes...
I... was able to pull completely back from
that child once she awakened, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
But perhaps because I forced it...
The exhaustion was overwhelming...
I lost consciousness along the way...
and that child surfaced once more.
choice_data_list: Suppressing it even for a moment i...
Suppressing it even for a moment i...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...It was... the very first time...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
........................Um.
Even after everything that just
happened...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If it wouldn't be... a burden to you,
Trainer...
—Would you walk alongside me... "together"...
from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Please... f-form a trainer contract...
with me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I feel that with you,
I... I might just be okay.
I will do everything in my power not to
cause you trouble, so...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No, it has to be you... ...Please.
Please...
please let me stay by your side...

Looking down anxiously,
she seemed so frail and helpless...
I wanted to reach out to her immediately...
yet my fingertips hesitated.
choice_data_list: (Can I truly support her all the way?)
(Can I truly support her all the way?)

text_block_list.text:
Yet a crimson haze enveloped and erased that
doubt. Ever since that summer night
when I wandered into that bewitching world—
I knew there was no turning back.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
............
I may be clumsy and unworthy,
but... please take good care of me.

That night was particularly suffocating.
The muggy heat clung to my skin,
making it hard to breathe.
Added to that was the intolerable itch on
my neck—and a heavy headache.

The end of this story has already been decided.
If so, why walk this path?
...Words unraveled,
dissolving into my subconscious.
Before sinking under once more,
what I saw was—
—Still in Love.
